# Darklight Chess Academy: full facts

Darklight Chess Academy is a chess academy based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It teaches live online chess classes to students worldwide and offline classes at two centres in Coimbatore, for children and adults from complete beginner to tournament level.

## People
- Founder: Karuppasamy.
- Co-founder and Head Coach: Manikandan (Under-15 National Championship participant 2016, Tamil Nadu state medalist).
- Marimuthu K: represented India at the Olympiad in Greece in 2021; multiple-time national champion in Open FIDE (VI).
- Gopinath: Open FIDE title winner.
- Mega Chakraborty: Asian silver medalist; represented India at the World Women Championship (VI) in 2024.
- Shankaranarayanan: coach.
Details: https://www.darklightchess.com/coaches/

## How classes work
- Live online lessons with a coach on a shared digital board, taught in English. Not pre-recorded.
- Small group batches or private 1-to-1 lessons. Levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced, tournament preparation.
- The first demo class is free and includes a level assessment.
- Timings are flexible and set in the student's local time.

## Fees
- Lessons start from INR 1,000 per hour. Siblings learning together get a discount.
- Fees are set in Indian rupees. Other currencies are indicative conversions only: https://www.darklightchess.com/pricing/

## Time zones (India is UTC+5:30, no daylight saving)
- UK and Ireland: India is 5.5 h ahead in winter (GMT), 4.5 h ahead in summer.
- Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Norway: India is 4.5 h ahead in winter (CET), 3.5 h in summer.
- UAE and Oman: India is 1.5 h ahead all year.
- Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain: India is 2.5 h ahead all year.
More: https://www.darklightchess.com/class-timings/
